That sounds lovely — glad you and Maria had a relaxing time together!

Would you like help turning that into an email, social post, or message? I can:

Subject: Weekend in the countryside
Hi everyone —  
Maria and I spent the weekend in the countryside exploring nature trails and enjoying the fresh air. It was a peaceful break — beautiful scenery, great walks, and lots of time to relax. I’ll share some photos soon! Hope you’re all doing well.  
Best,  
[Your Name]

Hey Maria —  
Thanks for a wonderful weekend. I loved exploring the trails with you and getting some fresh air — exactly what I needed. Let’s plan another getaway soon!  
Love,  
[Your Name]
